acceptance test: Exactly one new sentence is injected for each saved mode key; total added mode authority is four sentences; no WOF or Mid-writer path changes.
After a decisive fork closes a route, that route is absent for five subsequent turns unless a new ledger event explicitly reopens it.
Each active-crisis turn records at least one delta in danger, access, position, cost, knowledge, or commitment; an unchanged crisis cannot emit another wait pad.
A repeated inspection resolves to exactly one disposition: new supported fact, concise known-fact reminder, or honest exhaustion; it never returns the initial full description.
Each continuing NPC topic stores current goal, tactic, and threshold; a second exchange cannot reuse the first speech unless recap intent is true.
For every option set, each pair differs in at least one annotated dimension: objective, method, ally, risk, cost, relationship, or ending direction.
On action turns with System output, the first two sentences describe the fictional result and all XP/HP/status receipts follow it.
A successful action with complication retains the declared success; the complication adds cost, danger, reduced effect, or a new threat instead of negating it.
A required conclusion has multiple discoverable routes or a proactive recovery event; one failed check cannot permanently stall the scenario.
Across any ten group turns, no present player character is ignored when a clear spotlight opening exists; spotlight text never invents that PC's action.
At least two offered social futures change trust, obligation, access, exposure, or allegiance differently; combat is not the sole consequential option.
Every displayed reward stores a causal event ID and exact committed delta; rewards with no eligible event are suppressed.
A one-value change displays the relevant delta and total only; full character sheets appear only on explicit request or defined milestone.
Each major branch stores its central question and ending state; once answered, output ends or transitions instead of adding a neutral delay fork.
Exact or near-exact restatement is permitted only when repeat_or_restate intent is true; continuation intents remain subject to novelty or honest exhaustion.
A fixed 20–50-turn regression set for all four modes passes all twelve D9 gates, with failures linked to turn IDs and responsible owner.
Human review labels the top fifteen D6 anti-patterns on representative transcripts and confirms critic agreement before any gate blocks production output.
Research commentary and examples remain documentation-only; live prompt diff contains no source exposition, no new critic call, and no extra mandate pile.
